Our paver sealing process is designed to restore, protect, and extend the life of your hardscape using premium Trident products and proven installation methods.

We begin by removing the existing joint sand, followed by multiple deep-cleaning treatments using professional-grade Trident cleaning products to eliminate dirt, algae, mold, mildew, stains, and contaminants. Once the pavers are thoroughly cleaned and completely dry, we install fresh joint sand to stabilize the paver system before applying a premium Trident sealer.

Our high-performance sealers enhance the natural beauty of your pavers while protecting them from UV rays, color fading, stains, moisture, weed growth, insect intrusion, and joint sand erosion. The result is a durable, long-lasting finish that keeps your pavers looking their best for years to come.

Our Process:

* Remove existing joint sand
* Deep clean the surface with Trident cleaning products
* Perform multiple cleaning treatments as needed
* Install fresh joint sand
* Apply premium Trident sealer

Failing Paint Removal (Surface Prep for Repainting)

This service involves the removal of existing failing, peeling, and deteriorated paint from surfaces to properly prepare them for repainting. Areas where the coating has lost adhesion will be targeted and removed using a combination of mechanical methods and controlled cleaning techniques to ensure a stable, clean substrate.

All loose and compromised paint will be stripped away to prevent future coating failure and to promote proper bonding of the new paint. The goal of this process is to create a uniform surface by eliminating flaking edges, lifting sections, and weakened coatings that would otherwise impact the longevity and appearance of the new finish.

During the process, removed paint will break down into chips, flakes, and residue. These materials will be thoroughly collected and cleaned from the work area to ensure the surface is left clean, safe, and ready for the next phase of painting.

Note: This service focuses on removing failing and non-adhered paint. Sound, well-bonded coatings may remain intact unless otherwise specified.

Parking Garage Cleaning (Concrete Surface Cleaning & Degreasing)

Our parking garage cleaning service is designed to restore heavily used concrete surfaces by removing built-up dirt, oil stains, tire marks, and organic growth. We utilize commercial-grade pressure washing equipment combined with industrial-strength degreasers to break down and lift embedded grease, fuel residue, and grime from the concrete.

High-traffic areas such as entry/exit points, parking stalls, and drive lanes receive targeted pre-treatment with degreaser to ensure deep cleaning results. Surfaces are then thoroughly pressure cleaned to flush out contaminants, leaving the garage significantly cleaner, safer, and more visually appealing.

This service not only improves the overall appearance of the property but also helps reduce slip hazards and extends the life of the concrete surfaces.

Note: Heavily stained areas may require multiple treatments for optimal results.

Gate Pillar Soft Washing & Detail Cleaning
Service includes a low-pressure soft wash treatment of all gate entry pillars to safely remove algae, mildew, dirt, organic buildup, and discoloration from the stucco, stone veneer, and surrounding surfaces. All decorative stone areas, pillar caps, light fixture areas, and detailed sections will be carefully cleaned using professional soft washing methods designed to restore appearance without damaging the surfaces. Surrounding landscaping and nearby areas will be pre-rinsed and protected throughout the cleaning process.

Existing paver joints will be thoroughly cleaned and re-sanded to restore joint stability and improve the overall appearance of the surface. Fresh joint sand will be installed where needed to help reduce movement, minimize washout, and properly prepare the pavers for sealer application. This process helps ensure a cleaner finish, improved durability, and optimal long-term sealer performance.
